HL2MP_HudHelpBody.english:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

arabic.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

brazilian.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

bulgarian.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

czech.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

danish.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

dutch.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

finnish.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

french.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

german.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

greek.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

hungarian.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

indonesian.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

italian.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

japanese.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

koreana.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

latam.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

malay.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

norwegian.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

polish.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

portuguese.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

romanian.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

russian.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

schinese.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

spanish.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

swedish.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

tchinese.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

thai.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

turkish.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

ukrainian.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.

vietnamese.HL2MP_HudHelpBody:
Move: drag an element. Resize: drag its orange corner.

Zoom: mouse wheel over the canvas, + / - (including numpad), or the zoom selector. Right-drag to pan.

Snap: align edges and centers to nearby elements or the screen. Cyan guides show alignment. Hold Alt to move freely, or turn Snapping off.

Undo / redo: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, or the toolbar buttons.

Layout: position, size and quick centering. Appearance: colors, fonts and crosshair shapes.

Crosshair: choose All weapons or a specific weapon. Changes create an override; turn it off to inherit the shared crosshair.

Apply saves your layout. Closing with unsaved changes asks you to save or discard them. Cancel keeps editing. Saved custom slots remain saved. Default restores the original HUD.
